title: Hide network settings guidance tiles
summary: Hid the generated Network settings guidance and staged-patch summary prose blocks while preserving the existing control IDs used by JavaScript and tests.
reason: The visible generated tiles under Save Distributed Settings repeated low-value guardrail and patch-status text, adding visual clutter without helping the operator complete the settings workflow.
behavior_before: The Network settings drawer displayed generated guidance tiles for role, purpose, lifecycle guardrail, secret guardrail, setup notes, staged keys, preview/save summary, and runtime boundary immediately under the distributed settings action buttons.
behavior_after: The Network settings drawer keeps the distributed settings controls, status, preview, and save actions visible, but hides the generated guidance and staged-patch summary tiles.
manual_validation: TIMEOUT: ops/pipeline/runtime/PowerShell-7.6.0-win-x64/pwsh.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ops/scripts/release/test.ps1 -SkipToolIntegration -SkipEndToEndSmoke produced no output before the 124s command timeout
rollback_plan: Remove the hidden/aria-hidden attributes and unwrap the Network settings staged-patch summary in apps/desktop/webview/static/partials/page-network.html, then refresh the generated summaries.
notes:
Hide noisy generated distributed settings guidance and patch-summary tiles while preserving existing control IDs.
Refresh generated summary for the change packet.
Refresh generated summary after hiding Network settings guidance tiles.
Assert the Network settings guidance and staged-patch summary tiles remain hidden while IDs stay available.
